text:
Stalk $MSFT via $MSFU (Symmetrical Triangle Intact)

Prior breakout for $MSFT failed early this week and price action trades back within its 1-month symmetrical triangle. Intraday price print recapture the ascending line support and closed right beneath its 10-MA. On the weekly $MSFT remains a bullish flag. Would want another tightened price before Focus

Stalk $COIN via $CONL (Bullish Flag)

In addition to yesterday's highlighted bull flag in $MARA and $RIOT, $COIN also exhibit similar price structure with 3 days of price fade morphing the last 6 prints into a mini bullish flag. $COIN has more constructive volume contraction over the last 3 session to observe for RVOL based breakout next week.

Focus $GDX via $NUGT (Bullish Hammer at 200-MA within Bullish Flag Structure)

I earlier highlighted to Stalk this bullish flag structure in $GDX prior to Tuesday open. Tuesday breakout came too abrupt and early and follow session faded off without a follow through. Wedge pattern in this flag remains intact but latest tight bullish hammer print actually presents a lower risk and earlier opportunity to get into the trade on the anticipation of this potential flag breakout. No RVOL to monitor but i will always sit on my hands for the first 30mins of the market for all ETF based ideas.

$SIL (200-MA) $SILJ (50-MA) $GDXJ (200-MA) all has similar hammer print at key MA. $XAGUSD is bouncing off 50-MA while $XAUUSD remains lacklustre

Stalk $FPS (New IPO)

It was only about 5 weeks ago we were waiting for a high RVOL breakout for a similar flag structure that is building right now. Coincidentally they are both at the same area of resistance, building sideway range. Would prefer another tightened day before Focus for 30% RVOL within 30mins of open.

The most enticing opportunity today based on current market action and its tight range that's hovering. I am looking to do a buy stop order with stop based on yesterday's hammer low (90.94), not current print low (92).

Size will be smaller but it gives leaves room to build on this idea on a potential wedge breakout on daily, and flag breakout on weekly.

Focus $DELL via $DLLL 2x Long (Doji Reversal)

30mins into the market, $DELL has came off its intraday high. I am looking at re-ORH for entry (no rvol since it trades $3.7B avg dollar vol). It is about 62% LoD.

If i look back at the recent price break out of range in september, 3rd sept will be too wide to size appropriately, 11 sept is beyond 4x ATR% from 50-MA, 17th sept is chasing 4th day rally which will stop loss on T+3. This is the only best spot to squeeze in as of right now.

And if the gap resistance gets filled within the immediate session, it goes straight back onto my Stalk list.

A clean and concise reflection of strength. Not actionable right now for sure (111% LoD of ATR)

almost thought it gotten away when I saw it printing at day high.

always seek reason to avoid a trade.

no RVOL. no trade.

$SNOW is another no RVOL no trade lesson

$MSFT via $MSFU (Update)

Already 134% ATR move. Missed this for sure (if EOD print remains strong).

If you give me the same idea with just one day of prior compression, even if it appears 100 times, I won't be moving my finger anywhere near the buy button. I'd rather preserve my equity for better ideas on Monday.

Hard Rule #15: Minimum 2 days of compression before moving a Stalk setup to Focus. This is the spring-coil analogy.

$LRCX $STX $RDW $AEHR $ESTC $ALAB $FPS $FROG maybe $LUNR

the only trading philosophy you'll ever need to make your first million dollars in the stock market.

apply this principle when analyzing charts for opportunities x.com/jfsrev/status/…

2 trades is enough for me today (buy stops triggered)

goodnight and have a good weekend rest
